evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce ChitraMiti-12.8k, a synthetic benchmark of 12,874 Bengali planar geometry problems paired with structured 15-attribute descriptions, and NCTB-500, a complementary set of 500 diagrams manually extracted from Bengali school textbooks.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Evaluation of vision-language models (VLMs) for multimodal mathematical reasoning remains limited for low-resource languages and for geometry problems that require reading a diagram and a question together.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Together, ChitraMiti-12.8k, NCTB-500, and our evaluation protocol offer a standardized way to study Bengali multimodal geometry reasoning and, more broadly, whether VLMs actually check their text against what they see.
